resources.string: Count the drawer when the cashier changes
When someone signs in while another person\'s shift is open on this till, they are asked to count the cash and start their own shift. Each person then answers for the cash of their own shift.
%1$s\'s shift is still open on this till. Count the cash in the drawer now to start your own shift. Then any cash missing later shows in one person\'s shift.
All the cash in the drawer now. This closes %1$s\'s shift and starts yours with this amount.
The drawer had %1$s. Your shift starts with it.

What each person did at the till that is worth a look. None of it proves theft: a wrong item is taken off every day. Ask about items taken off after the customer saw the total, a drawer opened without a sale, cash missing from a shift, and one person with far more than the others.
